description: Read the original raw in R1_LOCAL/evidence/candidate_diagnostic/nominal_24V_gear_resource600/circuit.raw and actual circuit.cir, all four models. No other simulations. Save additional OUT, MOS drain/source/gate port currents using I(XQ:LD),I(XQ:LS),I(XQ:LG), I(XNEG:ddio),I(XNEG:dgr),I(RSRC),I(RF),I(RGS),I(RNEG),I(RSNUB),I(CSNUB). Internal names may be unsupported: preserve failure, do not create further retries. Analyze global and local peaks, source/drain KCL and charge integrals, compare solver/time-step sensitivity over COMMON complete window; switching phase may shift. Identify what is and is not established about diode recovery, Coss, LS and negative gate clamp. No fix yet. Do not modify any circuit component or vendor model. No recursively launched agents/models. Use shared lab.py for all new simulation runs: preregistration before execution is mandatory. At most 25 tool calls. Always finish result.json; worker PASS means evidence delivered only, never electrical acceptance. Do not run git, download software or write outside OUTPUT_DIR.
